advantage.I: realized suffix information content in nats, -log pi_theta_t(sigma_bar|sigma)
advantage.status: FROZEN BY AGENT 1; ambiguity resolved, flagged as D4
advantage.ambiguity: the paper's Eq. (1) regresses h to H/10 while its delta writes (H - h). Those are different units and the literal form degenerates to ~0.9*alpha*H, an uncentered bonus of order 6.2 at alpha=0.1 with early entropy ~69 nats, which would swamp (o - E[v]) in [-2,2]. The normalized reading is the only one under which alpha is an advantage coefficient.

measurement_resolution.why_this_block_exists: EXPERIMENT_FRAMEWORK section 3.3: compute the standard error FIRST, then set the margin.
consequences: Selecting the single highest mean EWR among 25 candidates on a 120-game lane is selecting mostly noise: pure noise alone produces ~0.14 EWR of apparent spread across 25 draws.

Worst-opponent stratum at 12 games has SE 0.1155, so a worst-stratum RANKING across 25 candidates is close to pure noise. Use it as an ABSOLUTE FLOOR FILTER, and set the floor below 0.622 or it will exclude candidates for noise alone.
The three-point rolling median over hours 6-12 is the only listed column whose noise falls faster than the candidate count grows; it should be the primary direction instrument.

Phase 14 precedent: a 128-game headline reordered against a 2,200-game re-evaluation. A confirmation re-evaluation of the top 2-3 shortlisted candidates at a materially larger paired game count is recommended BEFORE promotion.
measurement_resolution.status: recorded for Agent 7 and the operator; flagged as D6. Agent 1 has NOT changed common contract section 14.
